class CheckoutDialog(BaseDialog):
    """Selection d'un livre disponible et de l'adherent emprunteur."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        master,
        books: Sequence[BookView],
        users: Sequence[UserView],
        on_submit: Callable[[str, str], None],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(master, "Nouvel emprunt", height=380)
        self.on_submit = on_submit

        self._isbn_by_label = {
            f"{book.isbn} — {book.title}": book.isbn for book in books
        }
        self._user_by_label = {
            f"{user.user_id} — {user.name}": user.user_id
            for user in users
        }

        self.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        content = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        content.grid(
            row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=24, pady=(20, 8)
        )
        content.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            content,
            text=(
                "Sélectionnez un livre disponible et l'adhérent "
                "qui l'emprunte."
            ),
            anchor="w",
            justify="left",
            wraplength=380,
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12),
            text_color=("gray40", "gray65"),
        ).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 14))

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            content,
            text="Livre",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12, weight="bold"),
        ).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 4))

        self.book_combo = ctk.CTkComboBox(
            content,
            values=list(self._isbn_by_label),
            height=34,
        )
        self.book_combo.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 12))
        if self._isbn_by_label:
            self.book_combo.set(next(iter(self._isbn_by_label)))

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            content,
            text="Adhérent",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12, weight="bold"),
        ).grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 4))

        self.user_combo = ctk.CTkComboBox(
            content,
            values=list(self._user_by_label),
            height=34,
        )
        self.user_combo.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 12))
        if self._user_by_label:
            self.user_combo.set(next(iter(self._user_by_label)))

        self.error_label = self._make_error_label(content)
        self.error_label.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 4))

        self._make_buttons(
            self,
            confirm_label="Emprunter",
            command=self.submit,
            confirm_width=150,
        )

        self._first_focus = self.book_combo
        self.book_combo.bind("<Return>", lambda _event: self.submit())
        self.user_combo.bind("<Return>", lambda _event: self.submit())

    def _resolve(
        self,
        combo: ctk.CTkComboBox,
        mapping: dict[str, str],
    ) -> str:
        value = combo.get().strip()
        return mapping.get(value, value)

    def submit(self) -> bool:
        isbn = self._resolve(self.book_combo, self._isbn_by_label)
        user_id = self._resolve(self.user_combo, self._user_by_label)

"""Tableau defilant simple avec selection de ligne."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass

import customtkinter as ctk


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableColumn:
    key: str
    label: str
    weight: int = 1
    wrap: int = 0


class ScrollableTable(ctk.CTkFrame):
    ROW_COLORS = (("gray94", "gray17"), ("gray97", "gray15"))
    SELECTED_COLOR = ("#cfe4ff", "#1e3a5f")

    def __init__(
        self,
        master,
        columns: list[TableColumn],
        *,
        status_key: str | None = None,
        status_colors: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] | None = None,
        empty_text: str = "Aucune donnée",
        on_select: Callable[[dict[str, object] | None], None] | None = None,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent", **kwargs)
        self.columns = columns
        self.status_key = status_key
        self.status_colors = status_colors or {}
        self.empty_text = empty_text
        self.on_select = on_select
        self._row_widgets: list[ctk.CTkBaseClass] = []
        self._row_frames: list[ctk.CTkFrame] = []
        self._rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self.selected_index: int | None = None

        self.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        self.header = ctk.CTkFrame(
            self,
            fg_color=("gray86", "gray20"),
            corner_radius=8,
        )
        self.header.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 6))

        for index, column in enumerate(columns):
            self.header.grid_columnconfigure(index, weight=column.weight)
            label = ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.header,
                text=column.label,
                anchor="w",
                font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12, weight="bold"),
                text_color=("gray25", "gray80"),
            )
            label.grid(
                row=0, column=index, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=8
            )

        self.body = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(
            self,
            fg_color="transparent",
            corner_radius=0,
        )
        self.body.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        self.body.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.rows_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.body, fg_color="transparent")
        self.rows_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        self.rows_frame.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Contenu
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def set_rows(self, rows: list[dict[str, object]]) -> None:
        for widget in self._row_widgets:
            widget.destroy()
        self._row_widgets.clear()
        self._row_frames.clear()
        self._rows = list(rows)
        self.selected_index = None

        if not rows:
            empty = ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.rows_frame,
                text=self.empty_text,
                anchor="center",
                font=ctk.CTkFont(size=13),
                text_color=("gray45", "gray60"),
            )
            empty.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=24)
            self._row_widgets.append(empty)
            self._notify_selection(None)
            return

        for row_index, row in enumerate(rows):
            row_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(
                self.rows_frame,
                fg_color=self.ROW_COLORS[row_index % 2],
                corner_radius=6,
            )
            row_frame.grid(row=row_index, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=2)

            for column_index, column in enumerate(self.columns):
                row_frame.grid_columnconfigure(
                    column_index, weight=column.weight
                )
                value = str(row.get(column.key, ""))
                text_color: str | tuple[str, str] = ("gray15", "gray88")
                if (
                    self.status_key == column.key
                    and value in self.status_colors
                ):
                    text_color = self.status_colors[value]

                label = ctk.CTkLabel(
                    row_frame,
                    text=value,
                    anchor="w",
                    justify="left",
                    font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12),
                    text_color=text_color,
                    wraplength=column.wrap,
                )
                label.grid(
                    row=0,
                    column=column_index,
                    sticky="ew",
                    padx=10,
                    pady=7,
                )

            self._bind_row(row_frame, row_index)
            self._row_frames.append(row_frame)
            self._row_widgets.append(row_frame)

        self._notify_selection(None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selection
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def select_row(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not 0 <= index < len(self._row_frames):
            return

        self.selected_index = index
        for row_index, row_frame in enumerate(self._row_frames):
            row_frame.configure(
                fg_color=(
                    self.SELECTED_COLOR
                    if row_index == index
                    else self.ROW_COLORS[row_index % 2]
                )
            )

        self._notify_selection(self._rows[index])

    def clear_selection(self) -> None:
        self.selected_index = None
        for row_index, row_frame in enumerate(self._row_frames):
            row_frame.configure(fg_color=self.ROW_COLORS[row_index % 2])
        self._notify_selection(None)

    def get_selected(self) -> dict[str, object] | None:
        if self.selected_index is None:
            return None
        if not 0 <= self.selected_index < len(self._rows):
            return None
        return self._rows[self.selected_index]

    def _notify_selection(self, row: dict[str, object] | None) -> None:
        if self.on_select is not None:
            self.on_select(row)

    def _bind_row(self, widget, index: int) -> None:
        try:
            widget.configure(cursor="hand2")
        except Exception:
            pass

        widget.bind(
            "<Button-1>",
            lambda _event, row_index=index: self.select_row(row_index),
        )
        for child in widget.winfo_children():
            self._bind_row(child, index)

"""Catalogue des livres : recherche, filtre et actions d'édition."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tkinter as tk
from collections.abc import Callable

import customtkinter as ctk

from gui.components.dialogs import AddBookDialog, ConfirmDialog, show_error
from gui.components.table import ScrollableTable, TableColumn
from gui.service import BookView, LibraryService


class CatalogueView(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(
        self,
        master,
        service: LibraryService,
        on_mutation: Callable[[str], None],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self.service = service
        self.on_mutation = on_mutation
        self._books: list[BookView] = []
        self._borrower_names: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(3, weight=1)

        # Barre de recherche et filtres.
        toolbar = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        toolbar.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 8))
        toolbar.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.search_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.search_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(
            toolbar,
            placeholder_text="Rechercher par titre ou auteur…",
            textvariable=self.search_var,
            height=36,
        )
        self.search_entry.grid(
            row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=(0, 10)
        )

        self.filter_var = tk.StringVar(value="Tous")
        self.filter_menu = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(
            toolbar,
            values=["Tous", "Disponibles", "Empruntés"],
            variable=self.filter_var,
            command=lambda _value: self._apply_filter(),
            width=140,
            height=36,
        )
        self.filter_menu.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=(0, 10))

        self.refresh_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            toolbar,
            text="Rafraîchir",
            width=110,
            height=36,
            command=self.refresh,
        )
        self.refresh_button.grid(row=0, column=2)

        # Barre d'actions.
        actions = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        actions.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 8))
        actions.grid_columnconfigure(2, weight=1)

        self.add_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            actions,
            text="Ajouter un livre",
            width=150,
            height=34,
            command=self._open_add_dialog,
        )
        self.add_button.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=(0, 10))

        self.delete_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            actions,
            text="Supprimer le livre sélectionné",
            width=230,
            height=34,
            fg_color="#b91c1c",
            hover_color="#991b1b",
            state="disabled",
            command=self._delete_selected,
        )
        self.delete_button.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=(0, 10))

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            actions,
            text="Cliquez sur une ligne pour la sélectionner.",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),
            text_color=("gray45", "gray60"),
        ).grid(row=0, column=2, sticky="w")

        self.count_label = ctk.CTkLabel(
            self,
            text="",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12),
            text_color=("gray45", "gray60"),
        )
        self.count_label.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 6))

        self.table = ScrollableTable(
            self,
            columns=[
                TableColumn("title", "Titre", weight=3, wrap=260),
                TableColumn("author", "Auteur", weight=2, wrap=170),
                TableColumn("isbn", "ISBN", weight=2, wrap=150),
                TableColumn("availability", "Disponibilité", weight=1, wrap=110),
                TableColumn("borrower", "Emprunteur", weight=2, wrap=130),
            ],
            status_key="availability",
            status_colors={
                "Disponible": ("#15803d", "#4ade80"),
                "Emprunté": ("#b45309", "#fbbf24"),
            },
            empty_text="Aucun livre ne correspond à cette recherche.",
            on_select=self._on_selection,
        )
        self.table.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="nsew")

        self.search_var.trace_add("write", lambda *_args: self._apply_filter())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rafraichissement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self._books = self.service.get_books()
        self._borrower_names = {
            user.user_id: user.name for user in self.service.get_users()
        }
        self._apply_filter()

    def _apply_filter(self) -> None:
        query = self.search_var.get().strip()
        books = (
            self.service.search_books(query) if query else self._books
        )

        selected_filter = self.filter_var.get()
        if selected_filter == "Disponibles":
            books = [book for book in books if book.available]
        elif selected_filter == "Empruntés":
            books = [book for book in books if not book.available]

        rows = [
            {
                "title": book.title,
                "author": book.author,
                "isbn": book.isbn,
                "availability": (
                    "Disponible" if book.available else "Emprunté"
                ),
                "borrower": (

from collections.abc import Callable

import customtkinter as ctk

from gui.components.dialogs import CheckoutDialog, show_error
from gui.components.table import ScrollableTable, TableColumn
from gui.service import LibraryError, LibraryService


class LoansView(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(
        self,
        master,
        service: LibraryService,
        on_mutation: Callable[[str], None],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self.service = service
        self.on_mutation = on_mutation
        self.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(2, weight=1)

        toolbar = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        toolbar.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0, 8))
        toolbar.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.count_label = ctk.CTkLabel(
            toolbar,
            text="",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12),
            text_color=("gray45", "gray60"),
        )
        self.count_label.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")

        self.checkout_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            toolbar,
            text="Nouvel emprunt",
            width=150,
            height=36,
            command=self._open_checkout_dialog,
        )
        self.checkout_button.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=(10, 10))

        self.return_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            toolbar,
            text="Retourner le livre sélectionné",
            width=240,
            height=36,
            fg_color="#b45309",
            hover_color="#92400e",
            state="disabled",
            command=self._return_selected,
        )
        self.return_button.grid(row=0, column=2, padx=(0, 10))

        self.refresh_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            toolbar,
            text="Rafraîchir",
            width=110,
            height=36,
            command=self.refresh,
        )
        self.refresh_button.grid(row=0, column=3)

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            self,
            text="Cliquez sur une ligne pour sélectionner un emprunt à retourner.",
            anchor="w",
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),
            text_color=("gray45", "gray60"),
        ).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 6))

        self.table = ScrollableTable(
            self,
            columns=[
                TableColumn("book_title", "Livre", weight=3, wrap=240),
                TableColumn("author", "Auteur", weight=2, wrap=160),
                TableColumn("isbn", "ISBN", weight=2, wrap=140),
                TableColumn("borrower_name", "Emprunteur", weight=2, wrap=150),
                TableColumn("borrower_id", "Identifiant", weight=1, wrap=110),
            ],
            empty_text="Aucun emprunt en cours.",
            on_select=self._on_selection,
        )
        self.table.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="nsew")

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        loans = self.service.get_loans()
        rows = [
            {
                "book_title": loan.book_title,
                "author": loan.author,
                "isbn": loan.isbn,
                "borrower_name": loan.borrower_name,
                "borrower_id": loan.borrower_id,
            }
            for loan in loans
        ]
        self.table.set_rows(rows)
        self.count_label.configure(
            text=f"{len(rows)} emprunt(s) en cours"
        )

    def _on_selection(self, row: dict[str, object] | None) -> None:
        self.return_button.configure(
            state="normal" if row is not None else "disabled"
        )

    def _open_checkout_dialog(self) -> None:
        books = self.service.get_available_books()
        users = self.service.get_users()

        if not books:
            show_error(
                self,
                "Aucun livre disponible pour un emprunt. "
                "Ajoutez un livre ou attendez un retour.",
                title="Aucun livre disponible",
            )
            return
        if not users:
            show_error(
                self,
                "Aucun adhérent enregistré. Ajoutez d'abord un adhérent.",
                title="Aucun adhérent",
            )
            return

        CheckoutDialog(self, books, users, on_submit=self._checkout)

    def _checkout(self, isbn: str, user_id: str) -> None:
        self.service.checkout_book(isbn, user_id)
        self.on_mutation("Emprunt enregistré avec succès.")

    def _return_selected(self) -> None:
        row = self.table.get_selected()
        if row is None:
            show_error(
                self,
                "Veuillez d'abord sélectionner un emprunt dans la liste.",
                title="Aucune sélection",
            )
            return

        isbn = str(row.get("isbn", ""))
        title = str(row.get("book_title", ""))
        try:
            self.service.return_book(isbn)
        except LibraryError as exc:
            show_error(self, str(exc), title="Retour impossible")
            return

        self.on_mutation(f"Livre « {title} » retourné.")

        info = ctk.CTkFrame(
            self,
            fg_color=("gray93", "gray17"),

        info.grid(

        )

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            info,

        ctk.CTkLabel(

            text=(

                "une copie de sécurité des fichiers actuels."
            ),
            anchor="w",
            justify="left",
            wraplength=820,
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=13),
            text_color=("gray40", "gray65"),
        ).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        self.backup_button = ctk.CTkButton(
            info,
            text="Créer une sauvegarde (Backup)",
            width=250,
            height=38,
            command=self._create_backup,
        )
        self.backup_button.grid(
            row=2, column=0, sticky="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 10)
        )

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            info,
            text=(
                "La sauvegarde copie books.txt et users.txt en "
                "books.txt.backup et users.txt.backup."
            ),
            anchor="w",
            justify="left",
            wraplength=820,
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),
            text_color=("gray50", "gray55"),
        ).grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=20, pady=(0, 18))

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        stats = self.service.get_stats()
        self.cards["total"].set_value(stats.total_books)
        self.cards["available"].set_value(stats.available_books)
        self.cards["checked_out"].set_value(stats.checked_out_books)
        self.cards["users"].set_value(stats.users)

    def _create_backup(self) -> None:
        try:
            names = self.service.create_backup()
        except LibraryError as exc:
            show_error(self, str(exc), title="Sauvegarde impossible")
            return

        self.on_mutation(
            "Sauvegarde créée : " + ", ".join(names) + "."
        )

It only manifests under certain conditions (scrollbar dimensions changing during idletasks processing).

In J3 tests with 6.0.0, the same scrollbar existed and worked. Why now? The difference may be that `handle_mutation` refreshes ALL views including hidden ones while the catalogue is raised, changing the scrollbar geometry. Or because the banner appears/disappears, changing the available height. The scrollbar size change triggers `_update_dimensions_event` → `set` → `_draw` → `update_idletasks` → geometry event again → loop.

Actually, in J3 we refreshed only the current view. In J4, `refresh_all` refreshes all four views, and the scrollbars of hidden views get `set()` calls, possibly triggering the recursion. Hmm.

But the hang occurred on the update after `dlg.submit()` (the add book), which called `handle_mutation` → `refresh_all` → all views including users/loans. Then `banner.show` changes layout.

This might be a CTk 6.0.0 bug that also occurs in real usage (when adding a book, all views refresh). We must avoid it. Options:

Other views refresh when navigated to (`show_view` calls refresh). This also avoids hidden scrollbar redraws. But the catalogue mutation while on catalogue still refreshes the catalogue scrollbar. #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Tests des mutations et de l'auto-sauvegarde de LibraryService.

Execution depuis le repertoire agent/ :
    PYTHONPATH=build python3 tests/test_service.py

ou simplement :
    python3 tests/test_service.py

Le script ajoute automatiquement agent/build a sys.path (via gui.service).
Il ne modifie jamais agent/data : chaque test utilise un repertoire temporaire.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path

AGENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(AGENT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(AGENT_DIR))

from gui import service as service_module  # noqa: E402
from gui.service import LibraryError, LibraryService  # noqa: E402

if service_module._cpp is None:
    print("ERREUR : impossible d'importer bibliotheque_cpp.")
    print("Compilez d'abord le module :")
    print(f"  cmake -S {AGENT_DIR} -B {AGENT_DIR / 'build'}")
    print(f"  cmake --build {AGENT_DIR / 'build'}")
    sys.exit(1)


REPO_DATA_DIR = AGENT_DIR / "data"
REPO_DATA_FILES = ("books.txt", "users.txt")


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def snapshot_repo_data() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        name: digest(REPO_DATA_DIR / name)
        for name in REPO_DATA_FILES
        if (REPO_DATA_DIR / name).exists()
    }


REPO_DATA_BEFORE = snapshot_repo_data()


def expect_error(action: Callable[[], object], expected: str) -> str:
    try:
        action()
    except LibraryError as exc:
        message = str(exc)
        assert expected in message, (
            f"message inattendu : {message!r} "
            f"(fragment attendu : {expected!r})"
        )
        return message
    raise AssertionError(
        f"LibraryError attendu (fragment {expected!r})"
    )


def test_add_book_and_persistence() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        assert service.get_stats().total_books == 0

        book = service.add_book(
            "Le Petit Prince",
            "Antoine de Saint-Exupéry",
            "ISBN-1",
        )
        assert book.title == "Le Petit Prince"
        assert book.isbn == "ISBN-1"
        assert book.available is True

        stats = service.get_stats()
        assert stats.total_books == 1
        assert stats.available_books == 1
        assert stats.checked_out_books == 0
        assert service.load_error is None

        # L'auto-sauvegarde a ecrit le fichier immediatement.
        books_path = Path(tmp) / "books.txt"
        assert books_path.exists()
        assert "Le Petit Prince|Antoine de Saint-Exupéry|ISBN-1|1|" in (
            books_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        )

        # Une nouvelle instance relit le livre depuis le disque.
        reloaded = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        assert reloaded.get_stats().total_books == 1
        assert reloaded.get_books()[0].title == "Le Petit Prince"

        # Les champs sont nettoyes (espaces superflus).
        reloaded.add_book("  Titre  ", "  Auteur  ", "  ISBN-2  ")
        stored = {
            book.isbn: book for book in reloaded.get_books()
        }
        assert stored["ISBN-2"].title == "Titre"
        assert stored["ISBN-2"].author == "Auteur"


def test_add_book_validation() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("", "Auteur", "ISBN-1"),
            "obligatoire",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("Titre", "   ", "ISBN-1"),
            "obligatoire",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("Titre", "Auteur", ""),
            "obligatoire",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("Titre|corrompu", "Auteur", "ISBN-1"),
            "ne peut pas contenir",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("Titre", "Auteur", "ISBN\n2"),
            "ne peut pas contenir",
        )

        service.add_book("Titre", "Auteur", "ISBN-1")
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_book("Autre", "Auteur", "ISBN-1"),
            "existe déjà",
        )
        assert service.get_stats().total_books == 1


def test_add_user_and_persistence() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_user("", "USR-1"),
            "obligatoire",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_user("Alice", ""),
            "obligatoire",
        )

        user = service.add_user("Alice", "USR-1")
        assert user.name == "Alice"
        assert user.user_id == "USR-1"
        assert service.get_stats().users == 1

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.add_user("Bob", "USR-1"),
            "existe déjà",
        )

        users_path = Path(tmp) / "users.txt"
        assert "Alice|USR-1|" in users_path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        ).splitlines()

        reloaded = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        assert reloaded.get_stats().users == 1
        assert reloaded.get_users()[0].name == "Alice"


def test_remove_book_rules() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.remove_book("ISBN-INCONNU"),
            "Aucun livre",
        )

        service.add_book("Livre", "Auteur", "ISBN-1")
        service.add_user("Alice", "USR-1")
        service.checkout_book("ISBN-1", "USR-1")

        # Regle critique : impossible de supprimer un livre emprunte.
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.remove_book("ISBN-1"),
            "en cours d'emprunt",
        )
        assert service.get_stats().total_books == 1
        assert service.get_books()[0].available is False

        # Apres le retour, la suppression est autorisee.
        service.return_book("ISBN-1")
        service.remove_book("ISBN-1")
        assert service.get_stats().total_books == 0

        books_path = Path(tmp) / "books.txt"
        assert "ISBN-1" not in books_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        reloaded = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        assert reloaded.get_stats().total_books == 0


def test_checkout_and_return() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        service.add_book("Livre", "Auteur", "ISBN-1")
        service.add_user("Alice", "USR-1")

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.checkout_book("ISBN-INCONNU", "USR-1"),
            "Aucun livre",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.checkout_book("ISBN-1", "USR-INCONNU"),
            "Aucun adhérent",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.checkout_book("", "USR-1"),
            "obligatoire",
        )

        service.checkout_book("ISBN-1", "USR-1")
        stats = service.get_stats()
        assert stats.available_books == 0
        assert stats.checked_out_books == 1

        book = service.get_books()[0]
        assert book.available is False
        assert book.borrower_id == "USR-1"
        user = service.get_users()[0]
        assert user.borrowed_books == ("ISBN-1",)

        # Un livre deja emprunte ne peut pas etre emprunte a nouveau.
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.checkout_book("ISBN-1", "USR-1"),
            "déjà emprunté",
        )

        # La persistance conserve l'emprunt.
        reloaded = LibraryService(Path(tmp))
        reloaded_book = reloaded.get_books()[0]
        assert reloaded_book.available is False
        assert reloaded_book.borrower_id == "USR-1"

        service.return_book("ISBN-1")
        stats = service.get_stats()
        assert stats.available_books == 1
        assert stats.checked_out_books == 0
        assert service.get_users()[0].borrowed_books == ()

        expect_error(
            lambda: service.return_book("ISBN-1"),
            "n'est pas en cours d'emprunt",
        )
        expect_error(
            lambda: service.return_book("ISBN-INCONNU"),
            "Aucun livre",
        )


def test_backup() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        service = LibraryService(Path(tmp))

        # Aucun fichier de donnees : rien a sauvegarder.
        expect_error(service.create_backup, "Aucun fichier")

        service.add_book("Livre", "Auteur", "ISBN-1")
        service.add_user("Alice", "USR-1")

        books_path = Path(tmp) / "books.txt"
        users_path = Path(tmp) / "users.txt"
        original_books = books_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        original_users = users_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        names = service.create_backup()
        assert set(names) == {"books.txt", "users.txt"}
        assert Path(str(books_path) + ".backup").exists()
        assert Path(str(users_path) + ".backup").exists()
        assert (
            Path(str(books_path) + ".backup").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            == original_books
        )
        assert (
            Path(str(users_path) + ".backup").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            == original_users
        )

        # Un second backup est refuse avec un message explicite.
        expect_error(service.create_backup, "existe déjà")

        # La sauvegarde ne modifie pas les fichiers courants.
        assert books_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == original_books
        assert users_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == original_users


def test_repo_data_untouched() -> None:
    assert snapshot_repo_data() == REPO_DATA_BEFORE


TESTS = [
    test_add_book_and_persistence,
    test_add_book_validation,
    test_add_user_and_persistence,
    test_remove_book_rules,
    test_checkout_and_return,
    test_backup,
    test_repo_data_untouched,
]


def main() -> int:
    failures: list[str] = []

    for test in TESTS:
        try:
            test()
        except Exception:
            failures.append(test.__name__)
            print(f"ECHEC  - {test.__name__}")
            traceback.print_exc()
        else:
            print(f"OK     - {test.__name__}")

    print()
    if failures:
        print(f"{len(failures)} test(s) en echec sur {len(TESTS)}.")
        return 1

    print(f"{len(TESTS)} tests reussis.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(0 if main() == 0 else 1)
